Unknown ([[JN139]])| java1=[[Chika Fujimura]]| }} '''Cilan's Pansage''' (Japanese: '''デントのヤナップ''' ''Dent's Yanappu'') was the first {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} acquired by {{an|Cilan}}. He was given to Cilan prior to the start of ''[[Pokémon the Series: Black & White]]''. Pansage also appeared in the {{pkmn|games}} Cilan appears in. ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ====History==== =====Pre-series===== Pansage was given to Cilan at a young age when his brothers also received their first Pokémon. Years later, Cilan and his brothers became the {{gy|Striaton}} [[Gym Leader]]s, with Pansage being used whenever Cilan was challenged. One of these challengers, as revealed in ''[[BW019|A Connoisseur's Revenge!]]'', was [[Burgundy]], whom Pansage won against by defeating her {{p|Oshawott}}. ====={{aniseries|BW}}===== ======Unova====== Pansage debuted in ''[[BW005|Triple Leaders, Team Threats!]]'', where he showed him to {{Ash}}, who scanned him on his [[Pokédex]] before battling. [[File:Ash Oshawott battling Cilan Pansage.png|thumb|250px|Pansage battling Ash's Oshawott]] Pansage was the third and final Pokémon Ash faced in his {{pkmn|battle}} in the [[Striaton Gym]], where he went up against [[Ash's Oshawott]]. However, Pansage dodged all of his moves with ease and hit Oshawott quite hard with {{m|Bullet Seed}} and {{m|Bite}}. After Oshawott finally hit a midair Pansage with {{m|Water Gun}}, Pansage started charging {{m|Solar Beam}}, which petrified Oshawott with fear. In ''[[BW006|Dreams by the Yard Full!]]'', Oshawott deflected the Solar Beam and Pansage was soon defeated by Oshawott, earning Ash the {{Badge|Trio}}, his first [[Unova League]] Badge. At the end of the episode, Cilan takes Pansage with him while he travels with Ash and {{an|Iris}}. In ''[[BW009|The Bloom Is on Axew!]]'', Cilan used Pansage in a battle against [[Iris's Axew]] to help Axew gain some battle experience. Even though Pansage significantly lowered his own attack power (twenty percent lower, according to Cilan), Axew was thrown off by his attacks. The battle ended when Axew used {{m|Dragon Rage}}, but he accidentally misfired it, which caused a massive explosion that took Pansage and everyone else by surprise. In ''[[BW011|A Home for Dwebble!]]'', Pansage was used to help track down a group of {{p|Dwebble}} by using {{m|Dig}}. He was accidentally injured by the {{TP|Cilan|one Dwebble|Dwebble}} that he was trying to help. He was hit in the head by a small rock. Dwebble apologized and a friendship was formed between the two Pokémon. He later fell ill because of the injury and was given an herbal remedy made by Iris. In the morning, after Pansage recovered, he assisted Dwebble in getting its rock back. Pansage was very happy when Dwebble decided to travel with Cilan and himself, so that their friendship could continue. When Cilan was challenged to a rematch by fellow {{pkmn|Connoisseur|Pokémon Connaisseuse}} Burgundy in ''A Connoisseur's Revenge!'', he chose Pansage to battle her {{p|Sawsbuck}}, which he defeated after confusing it with Dig and hitting it with strong {{m|Bullet Seed}} and {{m|Solar Beam}} attacks, not taking a single hit in the process, showing that Pansage was a better battler than Ash and Iris originally thought. Pansage's abilities as a swimmer were shown in ''[[BW037|A Fishing Connoisseur in a Fishy Competition!]]''. Cilan used him in a fishing competition to battle a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Basculin}} both in and out of the water. He was able to subdue it with Solar Beam and Cilan was able to capture it. However, it was later released. Later, Pansage was used to help stop {{TRT}} from stealing the Pokémon that were captured by the fishing competition contestants. [[File:Cilan and Pansage in Luke movie.png|thumb|left|250px|Pansage and Cilan participating in Luke's movie]] In ''[[BW038|Movie Time! Zorua in "The Legend of the Pokémon Knight"!]]'', Pansage appeared in [[Luke]]'s movie alongside Cilan, as the main antagonists of the film. Later when Team Rocket had stolen {{TP|Luke|Zorua}} he switched roles and helped save Zorua when Cilan began to ad-lib his part, claiming to be a Magician now freed by Team Rocket's evil influence. In ''[[BW048|Battle For The Underground!]]'', he was let out of his {{i|Poké Ball}} by {{AP|Snivy}} when she found him among those that {{TRT}} had stolen from the [[Nimbasa City]] Pokémon Center, to help everyone escape from Team Rocket's train, however his Bullet Seed was not strong enough to break through the door. He later helped fight of [[Dr. Zager]]'s helicopter, while the other Pokémon worked out an escape. In ''[[BW051|Lost at the Stamp Rally!]]'', Pansage teamed up with {{AP|Tepig}} when his Trainer Cilan and {{Ash}} battled {{tc|Subway Boss}}es [[Ingo]] and [[Emmet]]. Battling their {{p|Eelektross}} and {{p|Chandelure}}, Pansage performed well, making use of the railings around the battle field. He and his partner battled well but were eventually defeated. [[File:Cilan Pansage teaching Solar Beam to Chili Pansear.png|thumb|250px|Pansage teaching Pansear Solar Beam]] In ''[[BW058|A Call for Brotherly Love!]]'', Cilan used Pansage to battle with [[Chili]]'s {{TP|Chili|Pansear}}, after they were challenged. During the battle, Pansage was revealed to know {{m|Rock Tomb}}, which he used to defeat the High Temp Pokémon. He also calmed Pansear down after it had a fight with its Trainer. Pansage, Cilan, and the others later helped Chili and Pansear train and even learn his own most powerful attack: Solar Beam. In ''[[BW059|Stopping the Rage of Legends! Part 1]]'', Cilan called upon Pansage to hold off {{p|Tornadus}} while Ash, Iris and [[Lewis]] ran ahead to {{p|Landorus}}'s shrine. However, Pansage was soon overcome by the legendary Pokémon who had a type advantage and was returned to his Poké Ball. Then in [[BW060|the next episode]], he helped rescue the members of the {{an|forces of nature}} from Team Rocket after they were captured, repeatedly using {{m|Solar Beam}} on Dr. Zager's helicopter until he was joined by Pikachu, [[Ash's Roggenrola]], [[Iris's Axew]], and {{TP|Iris|Emolga}} to cause the force field prisons trapping the trio to break. In ''[[BW067|Cilan Takes Flight!]]'', Cilan called upon Pansage to participate in [[Skyla]]'s "Air Battle" simulation. Skyla then predicted that Pansage would not be able to beat her {{type|Flying}} Pokémon. Pansage battled Skyla's {{p|Swoobat}} and proved her right by falling quickly to Swoobat's {{m|Air Cutter}} and {{m|Gust}} attacks without landing a single hit. Pansage was Cilan's chosen Pokémon for [[Ambiga Town]]'s [[Clubsplosion]] tournament. He battled [[Flora]]'s {{p|Gothorita}} in ''[[BW070|The Clubsplosion Begins!]]'' for the first round. After his Solar Beam collided with Gothorita's {{m|Psyshock}}, Pansage was able to win the battle, using Dig while covered by the smoke created by the collision. He later battled [[Stephan's Sawk]] in ''[[BW072|A Clubsplosion of Excitement!]]''. Pansage was overwhelmed when Sawk easily defended against his Bullet Seed with {{m|Close Combat}} and hit him hard. Pansage attempted to stop Sawk's {{m|Karate Chop}} with Bite, but it only allowed Sawk a better method of attack, slamming Pansage to the ground. After the brutal attack, Pansage was able to stand back up, only to immediately be defeated by {{m|Low Sweep}}, knocking Cilan out of the tournament. [[File:Cilan Pansage battling Forces of Nature.png|thumb|250px|Pansage battling the Forces of Nature]] In ''[[BW086|Piplup, Pansage, and a Meeting of the Times!]]'', when Cilan challenged Dawn in order to evaluate a Pokémon that had been raised by a {{pkmn|Coordinator}}, he chose Pansage to battle [[Dawn's Piplup]]. However, Pansage found it difficult to compete with Piplup's [[Pokémon Contest]] techniques; having a Bullet Seed knocked back at him by {{m|Drill Peck}} and Rock Tomb destroyed by a {{m|Bubble Beam}} [[Counter Shield]]. Eventually, Pansage launched a Solar Beam which clashed with Piplup's {{m|Ice Beam}} causing a firework-like explosion. Upon seeing this, {{an|Meloetta}} became over-excited and interrupted the battle; [[Jervis]] then called an official time out. In ''[[BW090|Jostling for the Junior Cup!]]'', Pansage was used in the first round of the [[Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup]] against [[Shepherd]]'s {{p|Galvantula}} and won the battle. Thus, Cilan advanced to the second round. In ''[[BW097|Unova's Survival Crisis!]]'', Pansage was sent out to battle the [[forces of nature]] and fired off attacks while riding on [[Ridley]]'s {{p|Golurk}}. In ''[[BW118|Secrets From Out of the Fog!]]'', Pansage was sent out to battle a {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}'s {{p|Liepard}}, using Bullet Seed to prevent it from attacking. However, his Bullet Seed collided with [[Barret]]'s {{p|Magnezone}}'s {{m|Magnet Bomb}}, and the resulting explosion knocked out [[Ash's Pignite]]. Pansage eventually defeated Liepard. ======Decolore Islands====== [[File:Cilan Pansage Gluttony.png|thumb|250px|left|Gluttony activated]] Cilan had entered Pansage in the [[Pokémon Sumo Tournament]] on [[Capacia Island]] in ''[[BW134|The Journalist from Another Region!]]''. In comparison to the other Pokémon entered, Pasange was considerably smaller. Cilan was aware of the weight disadvantage but insisted that their tactic would make up for it. However, Pansage was quickly defeated by his first opponent, a {{p|Hariyama}}, who knocked him clear out of the ring and into the arms of his Trainer. In ''[[BW140|Survival of the Striaton Gym!]]'', Pansage helped his Trainer to gather fruit for lunch. When the gang encountered an {{p|Abomasnow}}, Pansage offered a piece of fruit to the Frost Tree Pokémon, only to be attacked instead. The Abomasnow was revealed to be owned by [[Morana]] who had come to challenge Cilan. Pansage briefly reunited with Chili's Pansear and [[Cress's Panpour]] before confronting Morana and her Abomasnow with his Trainer. When the battle started, Abomasnow's {{a|Snow Warning}} ability lay snow across their battle field. Both Pokémon collided their Bullet Seed attacks, with Abomasnow's overpowering Pansages's, but not before Pansage dodged and struck Abomasnow with Dig, only to take a hit from Abomasnow's {{m|Strength}}. Pansage's Solar Beam was then matched by Abomasnow's {{m|Blizzard}}. Pansage then managed to avoid {{m|Sheer Cold}} with Dig and strike his opponent with Bullet Seed from within the hole. Pansage readied a Rock Tomb to finish the battle but was frozen by Blizzard. As Abomasnow charged towards the frozen Pansage using Strength, Pansage charged a Solar Beam that broke through the ice and stopped Abomasnow's attack. Pansage finally knocked out his opponent with Rock Tomb. After the battle, Pansage graciously healed Abomasnow with herbs from his head. ======Johto====== [[File:Cilan and Pansage.png|thumb|250px|Pansage and Cilan]] In [[BWS01]], Cilan had Pansage battle a {{p|Qwilfish}} he wanted to catch while [[fishing]]. After dodging a {{m|Hydro Pump}} he was able to land two successful hits with Bullet Seed and Rock Tomb. Cilan orders a Solar Beam to finish it off and Pansage begans charging energy from the sun while jumping toward Gyarados to attack at close range. Gyarados counters with a {{m|Flamethrower}} and greatly injures the Grass Monkey Pokémon. Seeing Pansage hurt Cilan calls off the battle and rushes to get him to a [[Pokémon Center]]. Upon arriving at the Pokémon Center Cilan explains to [[Nurse Joy]] about the Gyarados and its Flamethrower. Pansage is sent to the recovery room and after nervously waiting Nurse Joy tells him that Pansage will be fine and just needs some rest. While resting Cilan leaves him at the Pokémon Center while he goes to help bring Gyarados back to the lake. After Pansage fully recovered {{an|Brock}} tells him that he will take him to Cilan. Upon arriving Pansage sees his trainer trying to calm down the Gyarados, now on a rampage. After Brock sees that Gyarados is injured Cilan has Pansage use {{m|Grass Whistle}} to put it to sleep so Brock can heal it with a [[Potion]]. ====={{aniseries|XY}}===== In [[XYS06]], Pansage joined [[Clemont's Chespin]] in battling a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Eelektross}}. ====={{aniseries|JN}}===== Pansage appeared in a flashback in ''[[JN065|Thrash of the Titans!]]''. In ''[[JN106|Radio Lulled the Mischievous Stars!]]'', it was revealed that Cilan and Pansage had become listeners of Team Rocket's new radio show. In ''[[JN132|Partners in Time!]]'', Pansage watched Ash's [[Masters Eight Tournament]] match against {{an|Leon}}. In ''[[JN139|Must Be Our Heroes and the Witch!]]'', Cilan briefly used Pansage to battle a hypnotized Brock and his {{TP|Brock|Steelix}}. ====Personality and characteristics==== [[File:Elemental Monkeys anime.png|thumb|250px|Pansage, Pansear, and Panpour]] [[File:Cilan Pansage leaves anime.png|thumb|250px|left|Pansage offering his leaves to Morana's Abomasnow]] Much like his Trainer, Pansage is kind and cheerful to others. He was patient and gentle when battling the severely disadvantaged {{TP|Iris|Axew}} in ''[[BW009|The Bloom Is on Axew!]]'', as well as on the wild {{p|Venipede}} in ''[[BW022|A Venipede Stampede!]]''. He had no problem with adjusting his own attack power on these Pokémon. He is also very forgiving in ''[[BW011|A Home For Dwebble!]]'' as he held no grudge against {{TP|Cilan|Dwebble}} despite being injured by it and eventually made ill. However, he can also be very competitive as seen in ''[[BW019|A Connoisseur's Revenge!]]'' when he battled against [[Burgundy]]'s {{p|Sawsbuck}}, as well as quick-tempered as seen in ''[[BW025|Emolga and the New Volt Switch!]]'' when he was suddenly attacked while taking a nap and knocked out {{TP|Bianca|Minccino}} without being given orders. Pansage has a close relationship with [[Chili's Pansear]] in ''[[BW058|A Call for Brotherly Love!]]'', as the two happily greeted each other with a handshake. He also consoled Pansear after it and Chili had a fight, and was happy to train with it so Pansear could learn {{m|Solar Beam}}. This relationship was shown again in ''[[BW140|Survival of the Striaton Gym!]]'', while [[Cress's Panpour]] was also revealed to share this close bond. Pansage was also gracious in victory, as shown in the same episode, where he healed the Abomasnow that had previously been aggressive towards him. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|Grass||Cilan Pansage {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Bullet Seed|1=Bite|2=SolarBeam}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Bullet Seed|1=Bite|2=Solar Beam}}|image2=Cilan Pansage {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}||0=Dig|1=Rock Tomb|2=GrassWhistle|3=Vine Whip}}.png|caption2=Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Dig|1=Rock Tomb|2=Grass Whistle|3=Vine Whip}}}} {{anmov|grass|Bullet Seed|BW005|Triple Leaders, Team Threats!|rec=yes}} {{anmov|dark|Bite|BW005|Triple Leaders, Team Threats!}} {{anmov|grass|Solar Beam|BW005|Triple Leaders, Team Threats!}} {{anmov|ground|Dig|BW011|A Home for Dwebble!}} {{anmov|rock|Rock Tomb|BW058|A Call for Brotherly Love!}} {{anmov|grass|Grass Whistle|BWS01}} {{anmov|grass|Vine Whip|XYS06|rec=yes}} {{anmov/f|Grass}} ====Artwork==== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{grass color dark}}; background: #{{grass color light}}; font-size:80%;" |- | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{grass color dark}}; background: #{{grass color light}}"| [[File:CilanBW1.png|150px]] | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{grass color dark}}; background: #{{grass color light}}"| [[File:CilanBW3.png|150px]] | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{grass color dark}}; background: #{{grass color light}}"| [[File:CilanBW4.png|150px]] | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{grass color dark}}; background: #{{grass color light}}"| [[File:JN106 AS.png|200px]] | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{grass color dark}}; background: #{{grass color light}}"| [[File:JN139 AS.png|200px]] |- | Official artwork from

In his later battles, it has [[Evolution|evolved]] into {{p|Simisage}}. {{Pokémon |caption='''{{game|Black and White|s}}''' |gen=5 |ndex=0511 |pokemon=Pansage |gender=male |level=14 |type1=Grass |ability=Gluttony |move1=Work Up|move1type=Normal|move1cat=Status |move2=Vine Whip|move2type=Grass|move2cat=Physical |move3=Lick|move3type=Ghost|move3cat=Physical |move4=Fury Swipes|move4type=Normal|move4cat=Physical }} ===Mystery Egg=== {{bulbanews|New distributions for Black and White announced}} {{bulbanews|Mystery Egg event coming stateside}} {{main|List of local English event Pokémon distributions in Generation V#Secret Eggs|Secret Eggs}} A Japanese event randomly distributed an Egg that contained an in-game representation of Cilan's Pansage, [[Ash's Tranquill|Ash's Pidove]], or [[Iris's Axew]] via Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection. Like its animated series counterpart, this Pansage knows {{m|Bullet Seed}}, {{m|Bite}}, {{m|Solar Beam}}, and {{m|Dig}}. This event started on December 17, 2010 and ended on January 11, 2011. This Egg was also distributed at participating American {{wp|Toys 'R' Us}} locations from April 27 to May 31, 2011. {{G5event| ball=Poké| balllink=Poké Ball (item)| pokemon=Pansage| nick=Pansage| gender=m| level=1| game=5b| ndex=511| shiny=egg| typea=Grass| ot={{color|0070f8|(Hatcher's)}}
{{color|e82010|(Hatcher's)}}| id=(Hatcher's)| ability=1| ability1=Gluttony| nature=Brave| date=Apr. 27, 2011| met=Pokémon Event| encounter=eggapp| eggrec=ob| eggmet=(Place hatched)| eggdate=Apr. 27, 2011| type1=Grass|move1=Bullet Seed| type2=Dark|move2=Bite| type3=Grass|move3=SolarBeam| type4=Ground|move4=Dig| country=the United States| datedis=April 27 to May 31, 2011| obtain=hatch| black=yes| white=yes| egg=yes}} ===Pokémon Center Best Wishes Pokémon=== {{bulbanews|Japanese Pokémon Center to distribute four Pokémon from Pokémon the Series: Black & White}} {{bulbanews|More information on Japanese Best Wishes event Pokémon}} From August 10 to September 6, 2013, Japanese Pokémon Centers distributed an in-game representation of Cilan's Pansage. The distribution was split into four one-week periods; each week, players could receive one of four ''[[Pokémon the Series: Black & White]]''-themed Pokémon at random. The other three Pokémon distributed alongside Cilan's Pansage were [[Ash's Pikachu]], [[Iris's Axew]], and [[Professor Oak's Rotom]]. {{G5event| ball=Cherish| pokemon=Pansage| nick=ヤナップ| level=30| gender=m| game=5b| ndex=511| typea=Grass| otcolor=blue| ot=デント| id=08103| ability1=Gluttony| nature=Serious| encounter=fateful| met=Pokémon Cartoon| type1=Grass|move1=Bullet Seed| type2=Grass|move2=SolarBeam| type3=Rock|move3=Rock Tomb| type4=Ground|move4=Dig| ribbon=Wishing| country=Japan| datedis=August 10 to September 6, 2013| black=yes| white=yes| black2=yes| white2=yes}} ===In the spin-off games=== ====[[Pokémon Best Wishes: Intelligence Training Pokémon Big Sports Meet!]]==== Pansage appears in [[Pokémon Best Wishes: Intelligence Training Pokémon Big Sports Meet!]]. ==In the manga== [[File:Cilan Pansage M16 manga.png|thumb|200px|right|Pansage in ''{{ma|Genesect and the Legend Awakened}}'']] ===Movie adaptations=== Pansage appeared in {{ma|Genesect and the Legend Awakened}}, where Cilan sent him out along with his other Pokémon while he was in [[Pokémon Hills]]. ===Pocket Monsters BW=== Cilan owns Pansage in {{OBP|Pocket Monsters BW|Kosaku Anakubo}}. He uses it to battle {{TP|Red|Clefairy}} along with [[Chili's Pansear]] and [[Cress's Panpour]], with no official winner of the battle, but Clefairy takes advantage of their attacks to make himself some green tea. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|Grass|||}} {{anmov|grass|Vine Whip|PMBW02}} {{anmov/f|Grass}} ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Cilan Simisage Adventures.png|thumb|200px|right|Cilan's Simisage in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] [[File:Cilan Pansage Adventures.png|thumb|115px|left|As a Pansage]] Simisage first appeared as a Pansage. It assists Cilan and his brothers in the kitchen by using its leaves to make delicious tea for customers. Simisage, as a Pansage, first appeared in ''[[PS469|Welcome to Striaton City!!]]'', with its Trainer at the [[Striaton Gym]] where it uses the leaves in its head to prepare tea for {{adv|Black}}, {{adv|Cheren}} and {{adv|Bianca}}. [[PS470|Later]], it was used in the Gym battle against {{adv|Black}}, {{adv|Cheren}}, and {{adv|Bianca}} alongside Cilan's brothers' Pokémon. They proved powerful against Black's [[Tep]], [[Bianca's Oshawott]], and [[Cheren's Snivy]] with their type advantages. Although it managed to defeat Bianca's Oshawott and break its [[Scalchop and seamitar|scalchop]], Tep managed to revive its fallen teammates with some healing leaves that were previously knocked off of Pansage's head. With Chili's Pansear defeated, the challengers won the match when the time limit ends due to them having three Pokémon able to battle while the Gym Leaders only had two. In ''[[PS515|The Shadow Triad]]'', Pansage was used to battle the [[Shadow Triad]] at the [[P2 Laboratory]]. Although it, Pansear, and Panpour were at a disadvantage against their opponents, their Trainers gave them a boost of power by [[Evolution|evolving]] them with their respective [[Leaf Stone|Evolution stone]]. Pansage evolves into a Simisage, but is still unable to defeat its opponent despite becoming stronger. Eventually, they are saved by {{DL|Swords of Justice (Adventures)|Cobalion}}, {{DL|Swords of Justice (Adventures)|Terrakion}}, and {{DL|Swords of Justice (Adventures)|Virizion}}, who attacked both groups to rescue [[Kelden|Keldeo]], which the Shadow Triad had captured. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|Grass||{{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Cilan Pansage Vine Whip Adventures|1=Elemental Monkeys Work Up|2=Cilan Simisage Vine Whip Adventures}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Vine Whip as a Pansage|1=Work Up as a Pansage|2=Vine Whip}}}} {{anmov|grass|Vine Whip|PS470|Their First Gym Battle}} {{anmov|normal|Work Up|PS470|Their First Gym Battle}} {{anmov/f|Grass}} ===Pokémon Journeys=== [[File:Cilan JNM.png|thumb|200px|Pansage in {{ma|Pokémon Journeys}}]] Pansage appeared in a flashback in ''[[JNM19|Thrash of the Titans!]]'', when {{Ash}} was telling [[Goh]] about his travels with {{an|Iris}} in [[Unova]]. {{-}} ==In the TCG== Pansage was featured in the TCG. The following is a list of cards featuring '''Cilan's Pansage'''. {{cardlist/header|Cilan's Pansage|Grass|char=yes}} {{cardlist/entry|cardname={{TCG ID|BW Promo|Pansage|11}}|type=Grass|enset=BW Black Star Promos|ennum=BW11|enset2=BW Black Star Promos|ennum2=BW14|jpset=BW-P Promotional cards|jpnum=001/BW-P|jpset2=BW-P Promotional cards|jpnum2=004/BW-P}} {{cardlist/footer|Grass}} ==Trivia== * Pansage is Cilan's only {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}: ** That is not fully evolved. ** That is not dual-typed. ** That is of his {{t|Grass|specialty type}} as a Gym Leader. ** To have a confirmed gender. ** To appear in ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]''. * Simisage, {{TP|Chili|Simisear}}, and {{TP|Cress|Simipour}} are the only Pokémon in [[Pokémon Adventures]] to have used the move {{m|Work Up}}. ==References== ==Related articles== {{Animespeciesevo1|Pansage|Simisage}} * [[Chili's Pansear]] * [[Cress's Panpour]] {{Cilan's Pokémon}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Pansage}} [[Category:Cilan's Pokémon]] [[Category:Black and White characters]] [[Category:Animation characters' first Pokémon]] [[Category:Manga characters (Pokémon)]] [[Category:Pokémon Adventures characters (Pokémon)]] [[Category:Male characters (Pokémon)]] [[de:Bennys Vegimak]] [[es:Pansage de Cilan/Millo]] [[fr:Feuillajou de Rachid]] [[it:Pansage di Spighetto]] [[ja:デントのヤナップ]] [[zh:天桐的花椰猿]]
